title: Fundamentals of the cocyclic development of Hadamard matrices over loops
summary: This paper establishes a formal framework for the cocyclic development of Hadamard matrices over loops based on a novel cohomology theory with associativity obstructions. In this context, we formalize the notion of a loop-cocyclic Hadamard matrix, so that both the classical cocyclic Hadamard matrices over groups and the recently introduced pseudococyclic Hadamard matrices over loops are naturally embedded within this broader algebraic architecture.
